Company description: PM (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

Philip Morris International Inc., traded under the ticker symbol PM, is a leading international tobacco company engaged in the manufacture and sale of cigarettes, smoke-free products, electronic devices, and nicotine-containing alternatives. Originally established as a New York corporation in 1900, the enterprise expanded globally over the ensuing decades, building a prominent portfolio of brands led by Marlboro. A significant historical milestone occurred in March 2008, when Philip Morris International was spun off from Altria Group, establishing it as an independent, publicly traded entity focused exclusively on markets outside the United States. In recent years, the company has undergone a profound corporate transformation, strategically shifting its long-term business model away from traditional combustible cigarettes toward a smoke-free future. This evolution centers on the development, scientific substantiation, and commercialization of innovative reduced-risk products, most notably heated tobacco and oral nicotine alternatives, with the ultimate corporate objective of completely replacing cigarettes with smoke-free products as expeditiously as possible.
